messages:
rachel: SparkEdge asked for a short perf/W benchmark on their MiniBoard2 next Thu. Scope: int4 vs int8 kernels, seq=512, steady-state throughput, power draw, and one thermal run. They want both microkernel probes and full inference p95. Can eng-runtime + infra run this? @daniel @tom?

 daniel: Yep, we can. Needs: power meter cal (Yokogawa), firmware 2.4.0, and kernel flag ENABLE_VEC. I'll draft a run matrix today.

 tom: I pushed a bench image: gcr.io/redwood/bench:sparkmini-v1 and uploaded test vectors to s3://partners/sparkedge/mini2/. Quick smoke: "./bench --model llama-3b-int4 --seq 512 --concurrency 6 --iters 200 --power /dev/pwr0" -> ~690 toks/s, power 76W baseline 35W.

 priya: From SparkEdge: please include sensor calibration file, ambient temp, and a short README describing sampling rate and error bars. They want CSV + one slide summary.

 eng-bot: ci-bot: bench image sparkmini-v1 built (2026-04-12-15) :white_check_mark: logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/80222

 rachel: Action items:
 - daniel: finalize run matrix + runbook (owner)
 - tom: run patch vs no-patch microkernel probes on 3 boards and upload CSVs (owner)
 - priya: coordinate partner handoff and slide draft (owner)
 - infra: reserve rack slot Thu 06:00-10:00 PST and enable telemetry upload to s3 (owner)

 If we see thermal throttling or big latency tails, escalate to #eng-runtime. cc SparkEdge contact Marco in the final bundle. Thanks.
